job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain large-scale AI/ML models on Microsoft Azure platform.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing systems using APIs and microservices architecture.
Ensure high availability, scalability, security, and performance of deployed models by monitoring their behavior in production environments.
Develop governance policies for data management, model training, testing, deployment, and retirement.

Job Requirements :

6-11 years of experience in developing AI/ML models using various technologies such as Fast API development with Asyncio framework.
Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure services including Blob Storage, Service Bus, Functional Applications (App Support), Deployment & Management Tools.
Experience with Agile methodology for software development life cycle (SDLC) including design patterns like Microservices Architecture.
